documents.title: Brahms Op.118 programme notes
documents.text: Programme notes for the autumn recital. Brahms wrote the six Klavierstücke Op.118 in 1893, late in life, dedicating them to Clara Schumann. The second piece, the Intermezzo in A major, is the emotional centre: a lullaby that keeps turning back on itself. Performers should resist rushing the middle section in F-sharp minor.

documents.title: 十月演奏會門票安排
documents.text: 十月十二日晚上八時於香港大會堂劇院舉行獨奏會。門票分三級：正價港幣三百八十元、學生票港幣一百八十元、長者票港幣二百元。購票經城市售票網，開場前四十五分鐘入場。輪椅位置須預先致電票務處預留。

documents.title: 練琴筆記：左手跳音
documents.text: 今日練咗成個鐘左手跳音，第三十二小節嗰度成日彈錯。老師話我手腕太硬，要放鬆啲，用手臂重量而唔係手指去撳。聽日試吓慢速八十拍再練，唔好心急加速。

documents.title: Masterclass feedback, September
documents.text: Feedback from the September masterclass. The teacher praised the singing tone in the slow movement but said my pedalling blurred the harmonies in the coda. Suggested exercise: play the coda without pedal three times, then add half-pedal only on the bass notes. Also work on breathing before phrases.

documents.title: Studio rental invoice September
documents.text: Invoice INV-2026-0917 from Harbour Sound Studio. Rental of Studio B with Steinway D, 14 hours at HKD 650 per hour, total HKD 9,100. Payment due within 30 days by bank transfer. Recording engineer fee billed separately.

documents.title: 贊助品牌核實資料
documents.text: 贊助商青嵐茶室已確認以下資料可公開使用：品牌於二零一五年在灣仔創立，主打手沖烏龍茶，今季贊助金額不對外公佈。所有宣傳文案須於發佈前交品牌經理審批。

documents.title: Autumn tour social campaign plan
documents.text: Campaign plan for the autumn tour. Three weeks before each concert post a rehearsal clip, two weeks before share a story about the programme, one week before post a ticket reminder with the seating map. Target audience: university students and young professionals. Avoid discount language; emphasise the intimate venue.

documents.title: 观众问卷调查结果
documents.text: 本次演出后共收回二百一十五份问卷。百分之六十二的观众表示是第一次来听古典钢琴独奏会，最受欢迎的曲目是肖邦夜曲。多位观众建议增加中场讲解，并希望提供电子节目单。

documents.title: 鋼琴調音記錄
documents.text: 師傅今日嚟調音，話啲弦有少少鬆，因為最近天氣太潮濕。佢建議部抽濕機要日夜開住，濕度保持喺百分之五十左右，三個月後再約佢嚟睇一次。今次收費一千二百蚊。

documents.title: Tokyo itinerary for the November concert
documents.text: Fly to Haneda on 3 November, check in at the hotel near Kioi Hall. Rehearsal on 4 November from 2pm to 5pm. Concert on 5 November at 7pm. Return flight on 6 November. Remember to bring the black concert shoes and the printed music for the encore.

documents.title: Interview transcript: childhood and first piano
documents.text: 我細個嗰陣屋企好細，部 upright piano 係阿爺留低嘅。I started lessons when I was six, but honestly 我好唔鍾意練音階。後來 my teacher played me a Chopin nocturne, 嗰刻我先知道原來鋼琴可以咁樣唱歌。

documents.title: Recording session notes, day two
documents.text: Day two of the album sessions. Takes 4 and 7 of the Schubert impromptu are the strongest. The microphone pair was moved forty centimetres back to reduce hammer noise. Need to retake bars 54 to 61 because of a chair creak. Producer prefers a warmer tone for the final edit.

documents.title: Arts development grant application draft
documents.text: Grant application to the Arts Development Council. Project: a series of free lunchtime concerts in public libraries across Kowloon, introducing classical piano to working adults. Budget request HKD 180,000 covering venue logistics, piano transport, and an education pack. Deadline 30 November.

documents.title: 學生課程規劃（初級班）
documents.text: 初級班每週上課一次，每堂四十五分鐘。首月集中培養坐姿與手型，第二個月開始讀譜及簡單雙手協調。每三個月舉行一次小型學生音樂會，讓學生習慣在家長面前演奏。

documents.title: Wrist physiotherapy exercises
documents.text: Physiotherapist's plan after the wrist strain. Do gentle flexor stretches for thirty seconds, five times a day. Use a soft ball for grip strengthening, ten repetitions. No octave passages for two weeks. Ice after practice if there is any swelling.

documents.title: 團隊聚餐：豉油雞食譜
documents.text: 豉油雞做法：雞先用薑蔥同少許鹽醃半小時，然後落鍋用老抽、生抽、冰糖同八角慢火浸二十五分鐘，熄火再焗十分鐘。斬件上碟前淋返少少汁。適合八人份量。

documents.title: Recording equipment list
documents.text: Equipment for the home studio: a matched pair of small-diaphragm condenser microphones, two stereo bars, an audio interface with four preamps, closed-back headphones for monitoring, and a portable acoustic panel set. Borrowed items must be returned to the university music department.

documents.title: October newsletter draft
documents.text: Dear friends, this month I am preparing a programme built around lullabies and farewells. You will hear Brahms, Chopin and a new piece by a Hong Kong composer. Subscribers get early access to tickets this Friday. Thank you for listening and for sharing the music.

documents.title: 场地声学笔记
documents.text: 排练时发现大厅的混响时间偏长，低音区容易糊。调整方法：把钢琴往舞台前方推一米，琴盖开半，并在后排放置吸音板。观众入场后混响会减少，正式演出时踏板可以稍微多一点。

documents.title: Merch design brief
documents.text: 想整一批 tote bag 同 postcard 喺演奏會賣。Design 要簡單啲，用琴鍵同海浪做 motif，主色係深綠同米白。唔好用太多文字，logo 細細個放喺角落就夠。預算大概五千蚊，十一月前要交貨。

documents.title: Venue hire contract summary
documents.text: Summary of the venue hire contract with City Hall Theatre. Hire period 12 October 3pm to 11pm. Cancellation more than 60 days before incurs 25 percent of the fee; within 60 days the full fee is payable. The hirer is responsible for public liability insurance of at least HKD 10 million.

documents.title: 電台訪問預備問題
documents.text: 電台主持會問：一、點解揀布拉姆斯晚期作品？二、作為香港鋼琴家，你點樣吸引年輕觀眾？三、疫情期間你點樣保持練習？請預備每條問題約一分鐘的回答，避免講得太技術化。

documents.title: Practice log week 41
documents.text: Monday: scales and arpeggios 20 minutes, Chopin nocturne slow practice. Tuesday: memory work on the Brahms intermezzo without the score. Wednesday: rest day for the wrist. Thursday: full run-through recorded on phone; tempo dragged in the second half. Friday: worked only on transitions.

documents.title: 与赞助商的合作邮件
documents.text: 您好，感谢贵公司对本次巡演的支持。根据合同，我们会在节目单封底刊登贵品牌标志，并在每场演出前感谢赞助。社交媒体帖子需要在发布前四十八小时发给贵方确认，请提供联系人邮箱。

documents.title: Press release: autumn tour announced
documents.text: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE. Hong Kong pianist announces a four-city autumn tour, opening at City Hall Theatre on 12 October and closing in Tokyo on 5 November. The programme pairs Brahms late piano pieces with Chopin nocturnes and a commissioned work. Media enquiries to the press office.

documents.title: 學生音樂會家長通知
documents.text: 各位家長，學生音樂會改咗喺十二月七號星期六下晝兩點，喺琴行二樓演奏室。每位學生可以帶兩位家人入場，唔使買飛。請提早十五分鐘到，小朋友要著整齊啲。

documents.title: Concert accessibility checklist
documents.text: Accessibility checklist for every venue: step-free access to the auditorium, reserved wheelchair spaces with companion seats, large-print programmes, hearing loop availability, and clear signage to accessible toilets. Confirm each item with the venue manager two weeks before.

documents.title: 蕭邦夜曲解說稿
documents.text: 蕭邦一生寫了二十一首夜曲，今晚演奏的降E大調夜曲作品九之二是最為人熟悉的一首。右手旋律如歌唱般自由，左手伴奏卻要保持穩定，這種「彈性速度」是演繹的關鍵。

documents.title: Autumn tour budget sheet
documents.text: Budget sheet. Venue fees total HKD 86,000. Piano tuning before each concert HKD 1,200 each, four concerts. Flights to Tokyo HKD 7,800. Marketing HKD 15,000 including paid social posts. Expected ticket income HKD 140,000 if seventy percent of seats sell.

documents.title: Review excerpt from Arts Weekly
documents.text: Excerpt from Arts Weekly review: 'Her Brahms had the rare quality of sounding both old and newly discovered; the A major Intermezzo was given with a hush that held the hall.' Permission to quote obtained from the editor on 20 September for marketing use.

documents.title: 小红书文案草稿
documents.text: 第一次在大会堂开独奏会，紧张又期待！这次选了勃拉姆斯晚期作品，像写给自己的晚安曲。学生票只要一百八十港币，欢迎同学们来听。评论区告诉我你最想听哪首安可曲吧。

documents.title: Voice memo: content ideas
documents.text: Okay quick idea，可以拍一條 reel 講點樣揀演奏會服裝，因為好多人問我。Another one 係 behind the scenes 搬琴，好多人唔知原來搬一部三角琴要六個人。仲有可以做 Q&A，收集 followers 嘅問題。

documents.title: Instrument insurance certificate
documents.text: Certificate of insurance for one Steinway Model B grand piano, serial number 589214, insured value HKD 980,000, covering transit and venue use within Hong Kong and Japan from 1 October 2026 to 30 September 2027. Excess HKD 5,000 per claim.

documents.title: Encore options
documents.text: Possible encores: Schumann's Träumerei for a quiet ending, a Gershwin prelude if the audience is lively, or a Cantonese folk song arrangement for the Hong Kong concert. Keep encores under four minutes so the hall does not charge overtime.

documents.title: 品牌社交媒體使用規則
documents.text: 品牌規則：所有帖子必須標註贊助商帳號，不可使用其他茶飲品牌的圖片，亦不可提及價錢優惠。影片中如出現品牌茶具，須確保畫面乾淨，並在說明文字加上「合作」標示。

documents.title: Teaching philosophy statement
documents.text: I believe students learn music fastest when they are allowed to be curious before they are asked to be correct. Every lesson begins with listening, then imitation, then notation. Mistakes are information, not failure, and practice should end while the student still wants more.

documents.title: 直播设备清单
documents.text: 下周的线上演出直播需要：两台摄像机（一台拍手部特写，一台拍全景）、声卡、备用电源、稳定的有线网络。直播平台会提前一小时测试画面和声音，延迟控制在五秒以内。

documents.title: Email to concert photographer
documents.text: Hi Mei, thanks for agreeing to photograph the 12 October recital. Please avoid flash during the music and shoot only from the side aisles. We need 30 edited images within a week, including three portrait-orientation shots suitable for Instagram stories. Fee as agreed, HKD 4,500.

documents.title: 鋼琴比賽評語摘錄
documents.text: 評判話我嘅技巧好穩陣，不過音色變化唔夠多，特別係慢板嗰段太平，冇乜起伏。佢哋建議我多聽唔同版本嘅錄音，同埋留意呼吸位，等句子有方向感。

documents.title: Q4 content calendar
documents.text: October: rehearsal clips, programme story, ticket reminder. November: Tokyo travel vlog, backstage photos, thank-you post. December: student concert highlights and a year-end reflection. Post three times a week, mostly Tuesday and Friday evenings when engagement is highest.

documents.title: 首張專輯曲目表
documents.text: 首張專輯《晚安曲》收錄十一首作品：布拉姆斯間奏曲三首、蕭邦夜曲四首、舒伯特即興曲兩首，以及兩首由本地作曲家創作的新作。預計明年三月發行，實體唱片及串流平台同步推出。

documents.title: Notes on managing stage nerves
documents.text: What helps before a performance: a short walk outside, slow breathing with a longer exhale, playing the first phrase in my head rather than at the piano, and eating a banana an hour before. What does not help: checking social media or listening to other pianists' recordings backstage.

documents.title: 唱片合约要点
documents.text: 唱片合约要点：版税比例为净收入的百分之十二；母带所有权归唱片公司，七年后归还艺术家；艺术家保留现场演出的录音权利。如需在社交媒体使用专辑片段，每段不得超过六十秒。

documents.title: Loading dock and parking
documents.text: The City Hall loading dock opens at 1pm on concert day. Piano movers must register vehicle plates two days in advance. Performer parking is limited to two cars; guests should use the public car park on Harcourt Road. The stage door code changes weekly.

documents.title: Podcast episode outline
documents.text: Episode three outline：講下點樣由 classical pianist 轉型做 content creator。Part one 講第一條 viral video 點嚟，part two 講點樣平衡練琴同拍片，part three 答 listener 問題，例如使唔使買貴嘅 microphone。

documents.title: Recommendation letter for a student
documents.text: I recommend Wing Yan for the summer music scholarship. Over three years of lessons she has grown from shy beginner to confident performer, winning second prize at the district youth competition. She practises with discipline and supports younger students in the studio.

documents.title: 節目單內容稿
documents.text: 上半場：布拉姆斯《六首鋼琴小品》作品一一八。下半場：蕭邦夜曲四首，以及本地作曲家委約新作《港灣夜色》世界首演。全長約一百分鐘，設中場休息二十分鐘。演出期間請勿拍攝。

documents.title: Commission agreement for new work
documents.text: Commission agreement with composer Ka Lok Chan for a piano piece of eight to ten minutes, inspired by the harbour at night. Fee HKD 30,000, half on signing and half on delivery of the final score by 1 September. The performer has exclusive premiere rights for one year.

documents.title: 粉丝留言整理
documents.text: 最近一个月的留言中，最多人问的是练琴时间安排和如何克服紧张，其次是想要演奏会门票的折扣码。有几位粉丝请求出教学视频，特别是关于踏板的使用。

documents.title: Piano technician quotation
documents.text: Quotation for regulation and voicing of the Steinway Model B: full action regulation, hammer voicing to reduce brightness in the upper register, and replacement of two bass strings. Estimated two days of work, total HKD 8,600. Valid for 30 days.

documents.title: 排練時間表
documents.text: 十月份排練：逢星期二、四夜晚七點至十點喺琴行；十月十號同十一號喺大會堂試台，每次兩個鐘。十二號正日下晝三點入場試音，六點前要清場俾觀眾入。

documents.title: Thank-you note to donors
documents.text: Thank you to the twenty-three donors who supported the free library concerts this year. Your gifts paid for piano transport to seven libraries and reached more than nine hundred listeners, many of whom had never attended a classical concert before.

documents.title: 樂譜版權授權紀錄
documents.text: 《港灣夜色》樂譜版權屬作曲家所有，本人獲授權於二零二六至二零二七年度公開演出及錄音。網上影片使用片段前須通知作曲家，並在說明欄列出作曲家姓名及作品名稱。

documents.title: Video title ideas
documents.text: Title ideas for the rehearsal videos: 'What a pianist actually does the day before a recital', 'Practising Brahms slowly: a 10 minute session', 'Why I record every run-through'. Keep titles under sixty characters and put the composer name early.

documents.title: 巡演物流安排
documents.text: 钢琴运输由专业公司负责，每次搬运需要提前一周预约，费用约四千港币。东京站使用场馆自备的施坦威钢琴，不需要运输。乐谱和演出服装由助理统一打包，随行李托运。

documents.title: Diary entry after the first concert
documents.text: Tired but happy. The hall was nearly full, the intermezzo felt like a conversation with the audience, and I finally trusted the silence before the last chord. I rushed the Chopin a little. Afterwards a student told me it was her first live recital and she wants to learn piano.

documents.title: Call notes with tea brand
documents.text: 同青嵐茶室傾完 call：佢哋想拍一條 short video，喺茶室彈一段 Debussy，前後各五秒 show 茶具。Deliverable 係一條 vertical video 同三張相，pay 係一萬蚊，要喺十月底前 post。記住要佢哋 approve 文案先出。

documents.title: Daily warm-up routine
documents.text: Daily warm-up: five minutes of shoulder rolls and finger stretches away from the piano, then slow scales in contrary motion, then chords with a relaxed arm drop. Only after fifteen minutes move to repertoire. Skip fast octaves on cold mornings.

documents.title: 觀眾來信
documents.text: 多謝你上次喺圖書館嘅免費音樂會，我阿媽聽完之後成晚都哼住嗰首蕭邦。佢以前喺工廠做嘢，從來冇入過音樂廳。希望你之後可以再嚟沙田圖書館演出。

documents.title: Japan work visa checklist
documents.text: For the Tokyo concert the presenter is applying for a Certificate of Eligibility. Send them a passport copy, a performance contract, and a short biography by 15 September. Processing usually takes four to six weeks, so the visa interview should be booked in mid-October.

documents.title: 踏板教学视频脚本
documents.text: 开场：今天讲延音踏板。第一，换踏板要在和声改变的时候；第二，脚后跟不要离开地面；第三，练习时先不用踏板，确认手指连奏，再加踏板。结尾提醒观众每天练十分钟。

documents.title: Photo shoot moodboard
documents.text: Moodboard for the album cover shoot: late evening light by the harbour, dark green dress, the piano lid reflecting city lights, no visible logos. Shoot both landscape for the cover and square crops for streaming platforms. Avoid heavy retouching of skin.

documents.title: 去年總結
documents.text: 回望去年，最開心係開始咗圖書館免費音樂會，見到好多第一次聽古典音樂嘅街坊。最大嘅教訓係唔好同時接太多工作，手腕受傷停咗兩個月。今年要學識講唔。

documents.title: Approved biography fact sheet
documents.text: Approved biography: Hong Kong-born pianist, trained in Hong Kong and London, first prize at a national youth piano competition, founder of a free library concert series. Do not state any award that is not on this sheet. Short bio limit fifty words for programmes.
